senses.gloss: लट् laṭ, (personal terminations of) the present.
लटभ laṭa-bha, a. pretty, beautiful, charming: 🞄ā, f. fair maiden.

लाट lāṭa, m. N. of a country: pl. its people;
 🞄a. (ī) belonging to Lāṭa (ī, f. Lāṭa 🞄woman): -ka, a. (ikā) belonging to or customary 🞄among the Lāṭas.

लाटाचार्य lāṭa‿ācārya, m. N. of an astronomer;
 🞄-anuprāsa, m. repetition of a word 🞄in the same sense but in a different application 🞄(rhet.).
